speaker: Doctor
text: Let's start by understanding your significant medical history: can you describe any past neurological conditions, head injuries, or exposure to toxins like arsenic or mercury? Additionally, how long have you been experiencing these gait and limb ataxia symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: I see; to determine if this is related to your past history or a new issue, have you had any previous diagnoses of Multiple Sclerosis, Wilson's disease, or heavy metal exposure like arsenic? Also, have you noticed any changes in your vision, such as blurred spots or double vision, alongside these motor symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to Natalizumab use.

Please confirm if you have experienced any new visual disturbances, weakness, or numbness in the last few months. REQUEST TEST: MRI Brain with contrast. REQUEST IMAGES.
